items.title: Andrei Iosivas: Needs thumb surgery, bound for IR
items.description:
Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Wednesday that Iosivas tore a ligament in his thumb and will be placed on injured reserve, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.
